issues.on_page: Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Capital Assets 44,725 (positive, nonoperating revenues, Total enterprise column)
issues.issue: This year the row is a net gain, but its category is 'Loss on Disposal of Assets'. The rules list 'gain on sale' under Sale of Property. It does match the category used for this row in Lincoln FY2023-FY2025, so it is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Administrative Costs 57,914,309 (operating expenses listed by cost type)
issues.issue: Under the utility cost-type rule, cost-type rows take a cost category plus function 'utilities'. This row is categorized as the function 'utilities' with no function field. It is consistent with Lincoln FY2023/FY2024 but questionable under the rule.

The category is 'other' but the printed label is not other/miscellaneous. The page doesn't say what the settlements are, so no specific category clearly fits. It is already flagged for review. The same applies to detail[9].

The category comes from the fund name, not a printed label, and has no computed note. Elsewhere in the report the same label 'Intergovernmental' is intergovernmental/state aid, including the statement receipts line that contains this amount. Defensible, but it breaks the same-label/same-category rule.

issues.on_page: Payments Made to Developer 1,630,213 (Tax Supported Bonds Debt Service Fund, Expenditures -- Debt Service)
issues.issue: This is a judgment call. The line is printed under a Debt Service heading, and FY2023 prints the same fund's line as Developer Purchased TIF Payments (Lincoln's own category). This page does not say TIF, so economic development is defensible.

issues.extracted: West Haymarket JPA Fund lines from the p4 fund column
issues.on_page: West Haymarket JPA Fund has no budget schedule in the trim
issues.issue: Statement fund-column lines were added for a fund with no schedule of its own, while other funds use their schedules. The 2026-10-28 per-fund rule says not to add statement lines in that case. The notes say this matches the Lincoln FY2023/FY2024 approach, and the totals tie to p4.
